$ readlink /proc/1061/exe   # master 1061, before
/usr/sbin/nginx
$ cp -p /usr/sbin/nginx /usr/sbin/nginx.nx-new && mv /usr/sbin/nginx.nx-new /usr/sbin/nginx
exit 0
$ readlink /proc/1061/exe   # master 1061, after
/usr/sbin/nginx (deleted)
$ head -c 64 /proc/1061/cmdline | tr '\0' ' '
nginx: master process /usr/sbin/nginx -g daemon on; master_proce
